generations.prompt: Camera lies on the floor of a deep excavation pit at dusk, looking straight up. The pit's black, wet mud walls rise on all sides to a ragged opening of dim evening sky. An older woman with grey hair tied back in a dark field jacket leans over the rim of the pit and looks down at the camera, almost still: she breathes slowly, her head turns a little, a few strands of her hair move in the wind. Her face stays visible against the sky. Nobody else; nothing is lowered into the pit. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
